map.Jorgensen 关系：聚合角越大，摩擦固位力急剧下降。\n理想总聚合角：3°:
Jorgensen relation: the larger the taper, the sharper the drop in frictional retention.
Ideal total taper: 3-10 deg (1.5-5 deg per wall)
Clinically acceptable: <=20 deg
Retention index is proportional to height/diameter x cos(taper)

Height/diameter ratio (H/D) >= 0.4 aids retention and resistance.

map.输入：轴壁聚合角 6°/侧（总 12°），预备高度 4mm，基底直径 5mm\n:
Input: axial-wall taper 6 deg/side (total 12 deg), prep height 4mm, base diameter 5mm
Determination: taper and height are in the acceptable range for routine full-crown retention; if taper >20 deg retention drops markedly.
map.聚合角越大，轴壁越外敞，摩擦固位面积减小、冠易脱落；临床常控总聚合角 10~20: Larger taper makes the axial wall more flared, reducing frictional retention area and the crown easily comes off; clinically keep total taper 10-20 deg balancing retention and seating.
map.预备高度不够怎么办？: What if preparation height is insufficient?
map.可用冠延长术、桩核重建增加临床牙冠高度；过短会增加脱落风险，由修复科医师设计。: Use crown lengthening or post-core rebuild to increase clinical crown height; too short raises dislodgement risk, designed by a prosthodontist.
map.指修复体与基牙能承受咬合力而不折裂，要求洞壁有厚度、线角圆钝、无薄弱尖；具体以医: It means the restoration and abutment can bear occlusal force without fracture, requiring thick walls, rounded line angles and no weak cusps; specific to the dentist's preparation.
